name: Backstube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the heart of Tyrol!**

Discover the cozy charm of a **Backstube**—a traditional Tyrolean kitchen where rustic warmth meets authentic flavors. Nestled in the picturesque landscapes of **Tyrol**, these hidden gems offer a taste of home-cooked magic, from hearty mountain dishes to sweet treats like **Kaiserschmarrn**.

In **Innsbruck**, **Lienz**, or the charming villages of the **Zillertal**, step into a **Backstube** and let the aroma of fresh bread, crispy **Speckknödel**, and creamy **Apfelstrudel** transport you to a simpler time. Whether you're sipping a steaming **Kaffee** or savoring a bowl of **Käsespätzle**, every bite tells a story of Tyrolean hospitality.

Come, experience the soul of **Tyrol**—one **Backstube** at a time.
